title: How Ayatul Kursi became my nightly calm
translation: At night when anxiety peaks, reciting Ayatul Kursi slowly, understanding 'Allahu la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la naum' - He never sleeps, so I can.
lesson: We worry because we feel we must stay awake guarding our affairs. But Allah Al-Qayyum sustains all existence without sleep. Trust His wakefulness.
reflection: Started routine: recite Ayatul Kursi after every salah for 40 days. Effect: less anxiety, more presence.
